This snapshot records all eight captured affiliation requests for the 88-paper October 22 report and untouched responses from fresh gpt-6.1-sol subagents at low reasoning. Each agent received only the exact production request information (system prompt, paper source payload, strict response schema and settings) plus file-reading/output-storage mechanics. They did not receive parent history, known bugs or prior outputs. These are not live gpt-5.1 responses.

Requests were captured through the real SDK with a local mock transport. All eight responses passed production source validation without repair (304 claims). Full source review confirmed the five collapsed-space name repairs, Tohoku lab-wrapper removal, ETRI line-break normalization, and preservation of supplied campus/named-unit identities. Stanford is again recognized in Embodied Playground. The source quotes remain unchanged even when names are cleaned.

Mechanical acceptance is not semantic accuracy. Known remaining issue: REACT (arXiv:2610.28523) links Yoshimitsu Aoki and Mariko Isogawa to CMU through erroneous HTML author metadata, despite PDF source markers 2,3 supporting Keio affiliations only. CMU remains a valid paper-level institution for other authors. This same metadata conflict caused wrong author links in earlier emulations under the previous prompt; the uncontrolled samples do not isolate a causal prompt effect. Some named-university-subunit boundaries also remain ambiguous.

Historical v7 samples remain unchanged in ../model-led. They are tested for source-contract compatibility, not falsely labeled as outputs of this revised prompt. No accuracy percentage for production gpt-5.1 is implied. Live validation and source-quality corrections remain separate work.
